title: Multilingual preparation
lesson: Compare direct text with checked-in English translations and exact glossary preparation. The model is English-only.

material.instructions: Identify the single material described by the text.

criteria.concrete: Concrete, a building material made of cement, sand and aggregate.
criteria.steel: Steel, an iron alloy used for metal beams, bars and reinforcement.
criteria.timber: Timber or wood, including wooden boards and structural lumber.
criteria.brick: Brick, a fired clay block used to build walls.
criteria.glass: Glass, the hard transparent material used for window panes.
criteria.stone: Natural stone or rock, including granite, marble and limestone.
criteria.unknown: An explicitly named material outside this catalogue, such as copper, plastic, aluminum or rubber.
criteria.unclear: No single material can be identified: the material is unspecified or several alternatives remain possible.
